create_camera_from_fov: create a Camera object from width, height, and field of view in degrees
create_camera_from_intrinsics: create a Camera object from a 3x3 camera intrinsics matrix K
convert_depth_to_xyz: convert a depth image to 3D XYZ coordinates using a Camera pinhole model
smooth_binary_mask: dilate and erode a binary mask using OpenCV with configurable kernel and iterations
adjust_intrinsics_for_resize: adjust a camera intrinsics matrix K after resizing an image to a new width and height
